vendors.name: Wiz
vendors.offering: Agentless CNAPP: CSPM, attack path analysis and security graph across AWS, Azure, GCP
vendors.pricing: Annual contract; Wiz Essential $24,000 and Wiz Advanced $38,000 per 100 cloud workloads (AWS Marketplace)

vendors.name: Microsoft Defender CSPM
vendors.offering: Advanced posture plan: attack paths, agentless scanning, multicloud; foundational CSPM is free
vendors.pricing: Per billable resource (VMs, storage, DBs, serverless); current list price not shown on page; Foundational CSPM free

vendors.name: Palo Alto Networks Prisma Cloud
vendors.offering: Credit-based CNAPP; Business Edition covers CSPM, compliance, custom policies, remediation
vendors.pricing: Annual credit packs; Business Edition $9,000 per 100 credits, Enterprise $18,000 per 100 credits

vendors.name: Orca Security
vendors.offering: Agentless CNAPP with CSPM, vulnerability and risk prioritization across clouds
vendors.pricing: not public (private offers); Vendr reports median $98,701/year (104 purchases)

vendors.name: Prowler Cloud
vendors.offering: Managed open-source-based CSPM, 2,500+ checks across AWS, GCP, Azure, M365, GitHub
vendors.pricing: $99 per cloud account per month, or $79 billed annually; 50,000 resources pooled

vendors.name: Plerion
vendors.offering: CNAPP with asset inventory and posture, priced on combined cloud spend
vendors.pricing: Priced on monthly AWS/Azure/GCP spend; AWS Marketplace contracts from $15,000/year

vendors.name: Turbot Guardrails
vendors.offering: Policy-as-code governance with 14,000+ policies and real-time multi-cloud enforcement
vendors.pricing: $0.05 per control (one guardrail on one resource) per month, metered daily

vendors.name: AWS Security Hub CSPM
vendors.offering: AWS-native posture checks against CIS and AWS best-practice standards
vendors.pricing: Per security check, tiered from $0.0010 per check; free trial per account/region

paid_market_gaps.gap: Defender CSPM plan extensions can't be fully configured through built-in policy or Bicep; only pricing tier is exposed
Cloud-native CSPMs are per-provider, so multi-cloud teams must pick one and pipe the others' data into it
Leading CNAPPs start at tens of thousands per year, too costly for small multi-cloud teams

wtp_evidence: Buyers sign large annual contracts (Wiz $24k-38k per 100 workloads; Orca median $98,701/yr per Vendr, 104 purchases) and still file issues about missing policy-as-code control of paid Defender plans.
bundling_note: Azure gives Foundational CSPM free across AWS/GCP, Google's Security Command Center Standard tier is free, and AWS Security Hub CSPM is cheap per check.
summary: Crowded, well-funded market with free native baselines; no broad CSPM opening. Only a narrow wedge: policy-as-code management of native security plan settings (e.g. Defender extensions) for multi-cloud platform teams, likely a feature, not a company.
